scope: Independent static artifact-tool and final-checker engineering review only. Generic code plus synthetic fixtures; no report facts read, no artifact build, no AWS/network actions.

concrete_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Initial normalizers hid dropped bracketed numbers and word-boundary changes.
concrete_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Retain every literal, bracket, number and word boundary; collapse only layout whitespace with NFC. Exact first-use citation ordinals are preserved instead of globally deleting numeric brackets. Independently reproduced former failures now reject.

concrete_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Initial PDF substring membership accepted reordered paragraphs and deleted repeated occurrences; title-only source search could pass incomplete ledgers.
concrete_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Ordered non-reusable paragraph occurrences including labels must appear before a unique ledger boundary; ordered title/outlet/publication records must appear after it. HTML compares the exact ordered paragraph list, chip IDs/ordinals/URLs and full ledger metadata. Synthetic reordered, duplicated/deleted and ledger-loss cases reject.

concrete_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Hidden-parent source paths and unconstrained collection paths were admitted.
concrete_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: All hidden components, traversal, noncanonical paths, symlinks, repositories and credential filenames reject; exact date/kind native and collection locations are required. Renderer and partial-collection validation occur before any source file read.

concrete_findings_and_resolutions.finding: JSON evidence membership and ZIP self-inventory alone did not prove exact accepted input identity.
concrete_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: JSON evidence now equals exact own-feed records plus only the exact own-date availability augmentation. ZIP reviewer binds current source/market/freeze acceptance, every accepted date feed/card and every raw replay-inventory row; tampering negatives reject.

concrete_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Monthly retail collection audit did not check dated intros, labels, citation metadata or its full ledger.
concrete_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Dedicated monthly_retail_day compares each intro/title/label/paragraph and paragraph/global citation identity, URL and hover metadata against the exact own feed, plus ordered full source records. Six engineer negatives and independent Unicode/literal/hover/ledger cases pass.

concrete_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Receipt roles and delivery claims needed distinct scopes.
concrete_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Self static QA, this independent code review and actual final-artifact review use unique paths. Only actual full runtime final_review sets runtime_artifacts_reviewed true. Both local and unchanged shared retail require_review gates must pass and shared snapshot bytes match the original.

source_archive_scope.included: Exact own-date23feeds/cards/specs/component drafts/notes, rawRSS+parsed request caches+headline provenance, bounded market/action/Treasury inputs, acceptance/replay/input hashes, code and reference provenance.
source_archive_scope.excluded: Generic work/author/dependency scratch, repositories, credentials/hidden paths, other retrospective report-date filenames and circular final-delivery/archive-manifest receipts.

limitations: This accepts reviewed code and synthetic failure behavior only; no actual July HTML/PDF/JSON, layouts, archive contents or delivery has been certified. Root must run the hash-bound runtime artifact review after full build.
Publication and public routing/native-download proof are separate; this review performs no cloud writes, browser artifact rendering or external sends.
UTF-8/NFC and strict whitespace-preserving checks may reveal genuine PDF extraction/layout issues at runtime; do not weaken them to erase substantive text.
Source archive file-scope and exact-byte guards exclude credential/repository/author-scratch paths; this is not a credential-value discovery or a semantic secret scan of every financial headline.
